exam: 2024年12月 第1套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be goo…

sents.en: The weakening of the human connection to nature might be good for economic growth but is bad for people.
sents.cn: 人类与自然的联系减弱，或许有利于经济增长，却对人有害。

sents.en: A tipping point was reached in 2020 when human-made materials · such as steel, concrete and plastic · were found to weigh more than all life on Earth.
sents.cn: 2020年出现了一个临界点——钢铁、混凝土和塑料等人造材料的重量被发现超过了地球上所有生物的重量。

sents.en: Continuing to grow concrete forests rather than real ones is shortsighted.
sents.cn: 继续建造混凝土森林而非真正的森林是短视的。

sents.en: Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.
sents.cn: 仅仅是置身于最近的林地，就对人体有诸多健康益处，以至于伍德兰信托机构成功游说，将其列为可由医生开具的"处方"。

sents.en: Yet slipping from popular culture is the wonder and beauty of the natural world.
sents.cn: 然而，自然界的奇妙与美好正在从大众文化中悄然消失。

sents.en: For every three nature-related words in hit songs of the 1950s, researchers found, there was only slightly more than one 50 years later.
sents.cn: 研究者发现，在1950年代的热门歌曲中每出现三个与自然相关的词，五十年后只略多于一个。

sents.en: It is not a moment too soon that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test given that for decades children have been able to name more video game characters than wildlife species.
sents.cn: 青少年很快就能参加自然知识测验，这实在不算太早——因为几十年来，孩子们能叫出名字的电子游戏角色，比能说出的野生物种还要多。

sents.en: Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a "right to grow" law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens.
sents.cn: 补救这一社会弊病的一个办法，是议会通过一项"种植权"法案，允许任何人将利用不足的公共空间改造成果蔬园。

sents.en: The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil · while producing food sustainably.
sents.cn: 其用意是让人们在可持续地生产食物的同时，重新与土地建立联系。

sents.en: Vegetable planting has a respectable tradition.
sents.cn: 种植蔬菜有着令人尊敬的传统。

sents.en: In April 1649, locals responded to high prices and food shortages by cultivating vegetables on common land in Southern England.
sents.cn: 1649年4月，面对高物价与粮食短缺，英格兰南部的当地人通过在公地上耕种蔬菜来应对。

sents.en: The practice of throwing seed bombs to turn vacant plots of land green took off in 1970s New York, and has been revived (使复活) by green-thumbed (有园艺才能的) social media influencers who defy local US regulations in a war on ugly spots in cities.
sents.cn: 向空地投掷"种子炸弹"以使土地变绿的做法，在1970年代的纽约兴起，如今又被那些"绿手指"（有园艺才能的）社交媒体网红所复兴——他们无视美国当地法规，向城市中的丑陋角落宣战

sents.en: Apart from the urgent task of providing more healthy nutrients to those who increasingly can't afford them. Publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens connect what we eat to where it comes from·the means of production, if you will.
sents.cn: 除了向那些日益吃不起健康食物的人提供更多营养这一紧迫任务外，向公众开放的果蔬园还把我们吃的东西与它的来源联系起来——不妨说，就是生产方式。

sents.en: They can make unlovely spaces lovely, and marry use and beauty as well as help promote a sense of community.
sents.cn: 它们能把不讨喜的空间变得可爱，将实用与美观结合起来，并有助于培育社区意识。

sents.en: Plants are also, of course, our first defense against species loss and climate change.
sents.cn: 当然，植物也是我们抵御物种灭绝和气候变化的第一道防线。

sents.en: Such planting is a small step for humanity · in the right direction.
sents.cn: 这样的种植，是人类迈出的小小一步——却是朝着正确方向。
